title: Hosted API request eligibility and routing matrix for enterprise features
creator: Lena Morales
description: Problem: Enterprise inbound requests for hosted API feature changes (chat/streaming/tool-calls/structured outputs) arrive via multiple channels (support, CSMs, sales engineering, public feature requests). We lack a consistent eligibility/routing matrix that converts signals about SLA, data sensitivity, expected throughput, and compliance needs into deterministic intake outcomes: self-serve backlog, product-managed roadmap, Dedicated/Private sales engagement, or immediate engineering triage. This ticket defines a lightweight, operational matrix and acceptance criteria for automating initial routing and priority assignment for enterprise feature requests.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A documented eligibility matrix that maps request signals to 4 outcome buckets (Self-serve backlog / Product-managed feature / Dedicated/Private opportunity / Critical engineering hotpatch). 2) Example mapping rows for chat streaming, function/tool calling, and structured output requests covering at least 10 enterprise intake scenarios. 3) A short rubric for SLA mapping (latency/uptime/throughput) and data sensitivity that can be evaluated by CSM/AE. 4) Implementation plan for routing rules (console form + triage playbook + basic webhook to intake queue). 5) Pilot with three enterprise customers in next release cycle.
implementation_notes: Proposed owner: PM + Solutions Eng + 1 Backend Eng (8 days) + 1 Solutions Eng (consult). Steps: 1) Gather historical inbound requests (last 9 months) and classify by type and eventual disposition. 2) Define signals: customer_tier, expected_qps, expected_tokens_per_minute, data_classification (public/internal/regulated), need_for_kms, compliance_requirements, latency_target_ms, desired_model_variants, willingness_to-pay. 3) Build matrix with scoring weights and threshold rules. 4) Create triage checklist and a console intake form to capture signals. 5) Wire webhook to routing lambda that tags Linear issues and routes to appropriate team queue. 6) Run 2-week pilot and iterate.
decision_log: 2025-11-12: Agreed to avoid immediate automation of pricing decisions; route to sales for commercial negotiations. 2025-11-14: Decided to treat 'need_for_kms' and 'regulated_data' as hard blockers for self-serve. 2025-11-16: Chose three pilot customers (two finance, one healthcare) with diverse needs. 2025-11-18: Finalized initial scoring weights; product will own the matrix and Solutions Eng will provide customer context during pilot.
updates: 2025-11-12: Ticket created after weekly enterprise sync; dataset request opened for inbound request logs.
2025-11-13: Solutions Eng provided 6 canonical request examples and highlighted frequent asks about streaming-with-tools.
2025-11-14: PM/Legal call — confirmed regulated_data requires Private or Dedicated; added to hard-blocker list.
2025-11-16: Scoping meeting with Backend Infra — lambda-based router feasible; estimate trimmed to 5 points.
2025-11-18: Matrix draft complete; preparing intake form prototype for console and pilot kickoff next cycle.
